label: Shanklish
note: Egyptian shanklish is a different thing, made by fermenting areesh cheese (mish), not from yoghurt.

about.text: A ball-shaped cheese of the Levant made from strained yoghurt, about 6 cm across, rolled in thyme, za'atar or Aleppo pepper and aged and dried. Fresh it is soft and mild; aged, it turns hard and very pungent. Cheese from the Syrian coast around Tartus and Lebanon's Akkar is prized.

how.text: Strained yoghurt (labneh) is salted, rolled into balls and coated in dried herbs and spices, then air-dried and aged; it is often kept in olive oil.
